findings.title: Missing user now crashes the handler (non-null assertion hides undefined)
findings.description: findById now returns undefined for an unknown id (previously it threw NotFoundError, which the error middleware mapped to 404). The handler silences the type with `!` and dereferences user.email, so an unknown id throws a TypeError and returns 500. Check for undefined and respond 404.
findings.suggestion: Drop the `!`, `if (!user) return res.status(404).json(...)` before using user.
